mainEntity.name: How does IncuBrix turn long videos into shorts?

acceptedAnswer.text: IncuBrix transcribes long-form audio, detects viral highlight moments using natural language processing, automatically reframes horizontal video to 9:16 vertical shorts, and overlays animated kinetic captions.

mainEntity.name: Does IncuBrix put a watermark on free videos?

acceptedAnswer.text: IncuBrix allows new creators to start free and export high-resolution short-form video clips without mandatory branding watermarks on eligible trial credits.

mainEntity.name: What platforms can IncuBrix publish to directly?

acceptedAnswer.text: IncuBrix supports direct 1-click scheduling and publishing to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
